ch.h:
July 19th I planted a morning glory seed, and decided to start an observation journal for it.

July 20th, in the morning I woke up and gave it plenty of water. “How much longer?” “When will it bloom” 12-year-old me was pondered by all these questions. “When will I get to see the morning glory that I planted?”

July 25th, I woke to find that the morning glory had sprouted, it was just a tiny bud, but was enough to sprout a tree of happiness within me. “Good Morning Mr. Morning Glory, I said giving it plenty of water. And then my mother god mad. She said that I was giving it more water and that Mr. Morning Glory was already full.

August 11th, a typhoon hit where I was living. I stayed with Mr. Morning Glory the whole time so that it wouldn’t be blown away. And then my mom got mad at me, marching like a demon, she said I would catch a cold. But I was worried about Mr. Morning Glory so ignored her, and that caused me to get into a fight with her.

August 12th, It was still raining. I was in bed all day with fever. I kept trying to go to Mr. Morning Glory, but mom wouldn’t let me go. Mom did not care what happened to Mr. Morning Glory. Crying, I said, I’m never going to talk to mom again.

August 13th, I woke up to find that the morning glory was gone. Mr. Morning Glory wouldn’t have died if I had stayed with it. “I’m sorry, I’m sorry” I kept saying again and again. I was crying, when Mom brought a bloomed Morning Glory in a pot. Mom had moved Mr. Morning Glory to a pot during the typhoon for me. She protected ‘my’ Mr. Morning Glory in my place. “I’m sorry, I’m sorry” in the end I still ended up crying. But it was not because of sadness, but it was because I was happy.

August 30th, I watered the morning glory with my mom. Mr. Morning Glory is still growing up strong and healthy.

In the end I had realized but one thing, I too was a Mr. Morning Glory to my mom and she did all, for her own dear morning glory that she had raised with hard work, time and pain but most of all, with happiness.
